sloka: का प्रीती राज्यलाभेन तव देवि भविष्यति ।तादृशम् त्वममर्यादम् कर्म कर्तुम् चिकीर्षसि ॥२-३५-१३॥
transliteration: kā prītī rājyalābhena tava devi bhaviṣyati ।tādṛśam tvamamaryādam karma kartum cikīrṣasi ॥2-35-13॥

translations.english: All of us certainly will follow the path pursued by Rama. Abandoned by relatives, brahmins and virtuous men for all times, what pleasure will you derive by your lust for this kingdom? O Kaikeyi, why do you intend to trangress the limits of honour?
translations.hindi: जब लज्जा को छोड़ कैकेयी ने यह अति कठोर बात कही, तब तो महाराज दशरथ के दोनों नेत्र मारे क्रोध के लाल हो गये और खे कहने लगे
